definitions.gloss: land price; cost of land; price paid for land
definitions.explanation: The monetary cost or price of a piece of land, especially in the context of purchase or rental. Distinguished from the cost of the building itself.

examples.japanese: {都心|としん}は{土地代|とちだい}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: Land prices in central Tokyo are high.

examples.japanese: {土地代|とちだい}を{払|はら}い、{建物|たてもの}は{後|あと}で{建|た}てる{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: I'll pay for the land and plan to build the house later.

examples.japanese: {地方|ちほう}に{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}せば、{土地代|とちだい}が{安|やす}くて{広|ひろ}い{家|いえ}が{建|た}てられる。
examples.english: If you move to the countryside, land is cheap and you can build a spacious house.

notes:
Compound of {土地|とち} (land) + {代|だい} (price, cost). The suffix {代|だい} attaches to many cost-related nouns ({電気|でんき}{代|だい}, {交通|こうつう}{費|ひ}, etc.).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {土地代|とちだい}が{高|たか}い／{安|やす}い: land is expensive / cheap
- {土地代|とちだい}を{払|はら}う: to pay for the land
- {土地代|とちだい}が{上|あ}がる／{下|さ}がる: land prices rise / fall

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {地価|ちか}: land value — more formal, used in news and real-estate statistics
- {家賃|やちん}: rent (for a house/apartment) — recurring rental cost, not a purchase price
- {不動産|ふどうさん}{価格|かかく}: real-estate price — broader, includes buildings as well as land
